known_secrets.text: Sena has spent three years secretly compiling every elder's oral account of the Turning.
No two elder accounts fully agree with each other.
Elira's account is the only one that has never internally contradicted itself.
Tarek has refused a full interview with her.
Her assembled oral timeline lines up closely with Kalen's physical building-phase evidence.
